collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: An elder watches the children's biggest splash contest: enter the contest, or offer to judge instead.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The children are holding a contest at the deep, safe swimming pool below the rocks: whoever makes the biggest splash wins. (name1) hasn't jumped off anything in years, and has been watching for some time with a thoughtful expression. "Can anyone enter?" (he/she) asks.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The children are thrilled. (name1) climbs onto the rock, tucks up (his/her) knees and jumps. The splash soaks every child on the bank, the judges, and a pig that was asleep nearby. (name1) surfaces to a roar of applause and is declared champion for life. (He/she) is a bit stiff for two days and regrets nothing.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) sits on the bank and solemnly holds up fingers for scores. Every child gets ten. The last jump is clearly aimed straight at the judge and drenches (him/her) from head to foot. "That one," (name1) says, dripping, "gets eleven."
